title: Prevalence of Joint Contractures in Long-Term Care: A Systematic Review
author: H Prentice
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bpermjd6
materials: 17.Seddon H. Volkmann's Ischaemia*. Br Med J. 1964;1(5398):1587-

steps.title: Define Inclusion and Exclusion Criteria
steps.instruction: Establish the parameters for study selection to ensure a consistent cohort.

substeps.instruction: Include residents of care homes with a mean age >65 years.
Include studies available in English from journal onset to January 2020.
Include outcome measures of presence of contractures or reduction in joint range of movement.
Require studies to contain a definition of contracture or a measurement of severity, and data on the number of participants with contractures.
Accept any study design except single case designs (e.g., observational studies, RCTs).
Exclude studies reporting contractures resulting from burns, cosmetic implant augmentation, surgery, Dupuytrens or other named contractures, spine and neck contractures, or skin-related pathologies.

steps.title: Perform Literature Search
steps.instruction: Execute a comprehensive search of electronic databases and journals following PRISMA guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Search COCHRANE, EMBASE, CINAHL, Ovid MEDLINE, and Global Health databases using terms 'CONTRACTURE' and 'CARE' combined with Boolean connectors and truncation.
Include variations of care home terminology: 'care home', 'nursing home', 'residential care', 'long term care', etc.
Refine results by limiting language and population age fields.
Hand-search the Journal of Nursing Home Research.
Perform citation chaining (forward and backward searching) on all identified texts.

steps.title: Screen Titles and Abstracts
steps.instruction: Conduct an initial screening to remove duplicates and irrelevant studies using Rayyan.

substeps.instruction: Remove duplicate entries.
Screen titles and abstracts independently by two researchers (HP and JW).
Resolve any disagreements via a third researcher (SA).

steps.title: Screen Full-Text Papers
steps.instruction: Perform a blinded full-text review to determine final study eligibility.

substeps.instruction: Upload full-text PDFs to Rayyan for blinded screening.
Independently decide suitability based on inclusion/exclusion criteria (HP and JW).
Record reasons for exclusion according to PRISMA guidance.
Resolve disagreements via SA.

steps.title: Extract Data
steps.instruction: Extract technical data from selected papers into an Excel form using a modification of Cochrane guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Extract the following: author name/date, sample size, population, study design, duration, start/end date, mean age, main outcome measure, sex/gender, year, country, setting, joints measured, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and definition of contracture.
Extract risk factor data: baseline function, dependency, cognition, physical activity, medication usage, and medical conditions.
For case-control and cohort studies, extract relationships between variables, the model used (e.g., logistic model), and variables adjusted for.
Extract total number of participants and the proportion displaying contractures for prevalence assessment.
Contact authors via email to retrieve missing outcome data if possible.
Verify extracted data: HP reviews first, JW double-checks, and SA resolves disparities.

steps.title: Assess Study Quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate the quality of included texts using National Institute of Health (NIH) quality assessment tools.

substeps.instruction: Apply the specific NIH questionnaire relevant to the study type using Yes/No questions.
Assign a quality rating: Good (least risk of bias), Fair (some risk of bias), or Poor (significant risk of bias).
Exclude poor-quality studies from the meta-analysis if data is deemed sufficient.

steps.title: Perform Data Synthesis and Meta-Analysis
steps.instruction: Synthesize data using Stata (Version 16) and Metaprop for prevalence calculations.

substeps.instruction: Group studies by joint, definition, and possible risk factors for stratification.
Calculate joint-specific prevalence using the Metaprop Stata module.
Apply random-effects models for overall estimates to account for heterogeneity.
Test for heterogeneity using chi-square and I².
Generate forest plots with 95% confidence intervals (CIs).
Perform sensitivity analysis by omitting individual studies or stratifying by characteristics (e.g., age 80+, study design, follow-up duration).
Use robust regression to analyze the impact of outliers.

steps.title: Conduct Narrative Synthesis
steps.instruction: Perform a narrative synthesis for findings unsuitable for pooling or to complement the meta-analysis.

substeps.instruction: Perform preliminary synthesis via thematic analysis and tabulation of results.
Structure results into themes and a framework (performed by HP) covering individuals, settings, and risk factor theory.
Follow the Cochrane handbook guidance on narrative synthesis.
